economy_policy.title: BUDI95 Fuel Subsidy Scheme
economy_policy.desc: BUDI95 launched September 27, 2025, offering subsidised RON95 at RM1.99/L with 300L/month quota for eligible households.

economy_policy.desc: Peninsula diesel subsidy removed June 10, 2024; current price RM4.37/L. East Malaysia retains subsidy at RM2.15/L.

regional.title: East Malaysia Diesel Subsidy
regional.desc: Sabah and Sarawak continue diesel subsidies at RM2.15/L, creating regional price divergence.

cost_of_living.title: Regional Diesel Price Gap

items.title: Upcoming FOMC Meeting

so_what.delta: BUDI95 provides up to 300L/month at RM1.99/L for eligible households; market price is RM3.72/L as of June 2026.
so_what.omega: Fuel cost relief remains targeted, limiting broad-based inflationary pressure from energy prices.
so_what.xi: Households should maximise monthly quota to reduce out-of-pocket fuel expenses.
so_what.psi: Eligible families benefit directly; others face full market price burden.

so_what.delta: Peninsula diesel priced at RM4.37/L; Sabah and Sarawak still subsidised at RM2.15/L as of June 2026.
so_what.omega: Regional price disparity creates uneven cost pressures for logistics and transport sectors.
so_what.xi: Businesses operating in East Malaysia enjoy lower fuel input costs compared to Peninsula counterparts.
so_what.psi: Consumers in East Malaysia benefit from cheaper transport-related goods.

so_what.delta: Merdeka Center's June 2026 survey shows Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim approval rating at 52%.
